category_title: Latino students whose disruptive or defiant behavior is interpreted as 'uncharacteristic'
minimal_context: Gaby is filling out personal information on a CAT6 standardized test answer sheet in Mr. Beattie's classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at your CAT6 standardized test answer sheets so we can fill out the personal information section.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits calmly and attentively, looking at the test answer sheet.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I will now tell you which of you are counted as English learners. Gaby, please fill in the bubble that indicates that Spanish is the language most used in your home.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks up from the paper with a cheeky expression.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and fill in that bubble on your sheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I was born in this country, boy!
